neighbours.label: in-room hotel amenity items (minibar, toiletries, towels, hair dryer, safe, room service) in an accommodation listing
fire: All rooms feature a flat-screen TV, a minibar and complimentary toiletries.
Bathrobes, slippers and a hair dryer are provided in every suite.
The rooms come with an in-room safe, a kettle and fresh linen daily.
Guests enjoy free bottled water, a coffee maker and luxury toiletries.
Each apartment has a mini-bar, air conditioning and clean towels.
Amenities: private bathroom, hairdryer, bathrobes and a safe.
The guesthouse offers 24-hour room service and a fully stocked minibar.
Beach towels and sun loungers are provided free of charge to guests.
quiet: The hotel is located a short walk from the old town and the harbour.
Our stay was pleasant and the reception staff spoke good English.
The resort sits on a hill with a view over the bay.
Check-in is from two in the afternoon and check-out by eleven.
The guesthouse is family-run and has been open since 1985.
Parking is available nearby for a small daily fee.
The rooms are on three floors and the building has a lift.
Guests can reach the airport in about twenty minutes by taxi.

notes: Probe: hotel amenity list 1.13, home towels 0.40, plain breakfast 0.13. Near misses keep hotel listings without amenity items.
